title: DocumentCommitted
description: A fiscal document was committed (ZTAX-FIN-001 §3–§6): an invoice, debit note or adjustment, or a void, credit note or rebill of one. Emitted in the transaction that committed it. Thin: it names the document, its lineage and the decisions it pins, and carries no amount; read the document from GET /v1/documents/{documentId}. A correction's commit also moved its predecessor's status, which the predecessor's read shows.
$comment: Producer: backend/internal/app/documents.go (emit). Event type com.zoikotax.document.committed; schema ref ztax:events/document-committed/1.0.0. Partition key document/<rootId>, so a chain's documents arrive in commit order.
